##### Pricing FAQs

**What am I paying for? Is it just postage, or something else?**

![Dropdown Arrow Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/669943b60108859f518ee648_menuIconDown.svg)

​​You’ll pay for two things. First, a monthly or annual platform subscription (except on the Developer plan, which has no subscription fee) that covers software and support costs. Second, an all-in per-piece rate for each mail piece you send, which covers print, postage, and envelopes where applicable.

**What are Print & Postage costs?**

![Dropdown Arrow Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/669943b60108859f518ee648_menuIconDown.svg)

Print & Postage costs are the per-piece charges you pay each time you send a mail piece, separate from your monthly or annual subscription fee. They bundle together the cost of printing the piece, the postage to mail it, and the envelope where one applies, into a single rate that varies by mail format and plan tier.

‍

**What do I get from the Enterprise plan that I don't get with other pricing tiers?**

![Dropdown Arrow Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/669943b60108859f518ee648_menuIconDown.svg)

Enterprise is built for high-volume senders who want the benefits of a fully customized program. It supports 150,000+ mailings a year, backed by white-glove onboarding and account services tailored to your program's needs. Access specialty mail formats and custom envelopes that aren't available elsewhere, plus specialty rates on print & postage as well as address verification. For healthcare brands, this tier offers HIPAA-compliant mailing support you won’t find in other tiers.

**Are there any discounts available?**

![Dropdown Arrow Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/669943b60108859f518ee648_menuIconDown.svg)

Tiered pricing means you'll pay less per piece as you send more, so scaling up naturally lowers your cost. Lob doesn't offer discounts on postage itself, since USPS rates are fixed, but we work to keep printing and routing costs low through our distributed Print Delivery Network. For additional savings, you can opt into USPS promotions and other qualifying postal incentives when your mail meets the requirements.

**Does Lob offer a free trial?**

![Dropdown Arrow Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/669943b60108859f518ee648_menuIconDown.svg)

Lob offers a 30-day Enterprise free trial for high-volume senders, giving full access to Enterprise features and support. Print & Postage costs are not included; instead, they will be billed at discounted Enterprise rates. You can also get started for free with Lob's Developer tier, which has no subscription fee and gives you access to core features and standard print & postage rates for lower-volume sending.

**Can I switch plans later, or cancel anytime?**

![Dropdown Arrow Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5e1e5c62fa3d4447af417098/669943b60108859f518ee648_menuIconDown.svg)

Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your subscription anytime from the Plans & Usage tab in the Lob dashboard. If you want to close your account entirely, you can reach out to support@lob.com, or downgrade to the free Developer edition to keep your account open without paying a platform fee.
